biggest_catch: Your referral only counts if the referred person opens a Basic Share account with at least $25 AND a secondary sub-account or loan product — and payouts are capped at $250 per calendar year.
catches: To qualify for the $25 incentive, the referred person must open a Serve Basic Share account with a minimum of $25 AND open a secondary sub-account or a loan product.
Payout for referrals is capped at $250 per calendar year (ten $25 referrals).
Referring members must be 18 or older; referred person must satisfy Serve's new membership requirements (servecu.org/become-a-member).
The $25 incentive is deposited into each member's Serve Basic Share account; allow processing time after requirements are met.
Membership and loan approval subject to eligibility and approval; reaching 'SCU Chief' rank after 3 referrals unlocks non-cash perks only.

steps: Share Serve Credit Union with family, friends, and coworkers who may be eligible to join — make sure they mention your name during the process.
Your referral opens a Serve Basic Share account with a minimum of $25 and satisfies Serve's new membership requirements.
Your referral also opens a secondary sub-account or a loan product.
You receive $25 deposited into your Serve Basic Share account (referral also receives $25); up to $250 per calendar year.
